name: Collapse (Magomed Khalilov)
milestone_by_age_26: Won The International 10 with Team Spirit in October 2021 at age 19, earning approximately $3.69M in prize money.
early_history_summary: Magomed 'Collapse' Khalilov started playing Dota 2 at age 13 in Makhachkala, Dagestan, after learning about it from friends. He played from PC cafes and faced parental opposition, but began competing seriously in 2017, eventually joining Team Spirit in December 2020 and winning The International 10 in October 2021 at age 19.
family_context_summary: Born in Makhachkala, Dagestan, Russia; father is a chief physician at a hospital who initially opposed gaming but later supported after seeing professional opportunities. Trained in hand-to-hand combat and Judo in youth.
parent_family_domain_summary: Father is a medical doctor (chief physician); no gaming or technology domain expertise in family.
primary_early_advantage_tags: Dagestan, PC cafes, parental conflict, CIS Dota culture, Team Spirit, Korb3n mentorship
evidence_summary: Collapse's journey from PC cafes in Dagestan to two-time TI champion illustrates both exceptional game talent and significant adversity overcome. His father, a chief physician, initially opposed his gaming career and wanted him to attend medical school, but was persuaded by Team Spirit's manager Korb3n who flew him to Moscow to demonstrate the professional opportunity. Collapse trained in hand-to-hand combat and Judo in his youth, and his parents came to fully support his career after he started earning a salary. His primary advantages were deep immersion in the CIS Dota 2 culture, the exceptional Team Spirit roster, and a constraint-driven urgency from parental opposition.

name: Ropz (Robin Kool)
milestone_by_age_26: Won PGL Major Antwerp 2022 with FaZe Clan at age 22, becoming the first Estonian to win a CS:GO Major; was also named to HLTV Top 20 every year since his 2017 debut at age 17.
early_history_summary: Robin 'ropz' Kool was introduced to Counter-Strike 1.6 at age 7 by his older brother and mastered movement mechanics on KZ servers. He began competitive CS:GO in 2015 at age 15, joined mousesports in 2017 at 17, and was named to the HLTV Top 20 in his debut year, becoming the first Estonian to achieve this recognition.
family_context_summary: Born in Jõgeva, Estonia; father owned large farms that went bankrupt, leading to loss of the family home; father tragically took his own life. Mother Gea supported his gaming career. Has an older brother who introduced him to Counter-Strike.
parent_family_domain_summary: Father was a farmer; no gaming or technology domain expertise in family. Older brother introduced him to gaming but was not a professional player.
primary_early_advantage_tags: family tragedy, Estonia, early CS start at 7, FACEIT pipeline, father bankruptcy, mousesports
evidence_summary: Ropz's decade-long journey from CS 1.6 at age 7 to HLTV Top 20 at 17 reflects extraordinary early specialization and mechanical depth. His father owned large farms in Estonia that went bankrupt, leading to the loss of the family home and his father's tragic suicide, creating significant adversity that channeled into gaming focus. His mother Gea supported his career, and his older brother introduced him to Counter-Strike. His primary advantages were extreme early reps (starting at 7), the FACEIT online competitive platform, and the mousesports development pipeline, all forged through significant family adversity.
